{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_clean'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Also compute the number of completed orders
n_completed = len(completed_orders)

# Print both values
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue}")
print(f"Number of completed orders: {n_completed}")"}
